stats.label: Faster delivery on a typical build when AI does the heavy lifting

benefitsSection.title: What you get working with us.
benefitsSection.lead: AI speeds up the work; it doesn't replace engineering judgment. We pair [AI-assisted development practices](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/rules-to-better-ai-development) with code review, testing, and the 1-week Scrum cadence enterprise teams rely on.

items.title: Faster delivery
items.description: AI handles the repetitive parts of coding, so features that used to take weeks land in days. The review and testing still happen — they don't get skipped to hit a date.

items.title: Enterprise-grade quality
items.description: Every change goes through code review and automated tests, with a senior consultant keeping an eye on the architecture and security.

items.title: North American communication
items.description: Your Scrum Master is based in North America and runs standups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder updates during your working hours.

items.title: Scrum-led delivery
items.description: We work in 1-week sprints and show you working software at the end of each one. You can see what's done, what's next, and roughly when it'll be ready.

items.title: Flexible team structure
items.description: Add senior architects or more engineers when the work picks up, and scale back when it quiets down. You're not locked into a fixed headcount.

items.title: Cost-effective scaling
items.description: Mix senior oversight with a more affordable delivery team, so you're not paying architect rates for every line of code.

servicesSection.title: From a quick prototype to a system you run the business on.
servicesSection.lead: Whether it's a rough idea or a platform you'll depend on for years, the same senior people and the same process see it through.

items.title: AI-assisted software development
items.description: Applications built with our [AI-assisted development workflow](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/ai-assisted-development-workflow) — specs, code generation, QA, and review. Senior engineers steer the tooling, so what you ship is quick to build and easy to maintain later.

items.title: Legacy app modernization
items.description: Move aging .NET, WinForms, and on-prem systems to the cloud a piece at a time, so the business keeps running while you do it.

items.title: Custom business applications
items.description: Internal tools shaped around how your team actually works, and wired into the systems you already use.

items.title: Technical consulting and architecture
items.description: Senior architects help you get the big technical calls right early, while they're still cheap to change.

howSection.title: A predictable path from first conversation to live software.
howSection.lead: No discovery theater. No vague proposals. You will see a working increment in the first sprint.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.description: A 30-minute call with a senior consultant to talk through your goals, your constraints, and what a good outcome looks like.

steps.title: Solution design
steps.description: We work out the architecture, timeline, and team, then write it up as a proposal you can actually plan around.

steps.title: Rapid AI-assisted build
steps.description: Engineers build features with AI in the loop, and everything is reviewed, tested, and deployed as it goes. For early validation, see our rule on [AI tools in prototype development](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/ai-for-prototype-development).

steps.title: Live in production, improving weekly
steps.description: Launch isn't the end of it. We keep shipping features, fixes, and tweaks every week in 1-week sprints.

whySection.title: Why teams pick SSW.
whySection.lead: SSW has been building enterprise software for over 30 years. We're now putting that experience to work with AI for clients across the U.S. and Canada.

rows.title: Experienced teams, sized to your project
rows.description: Senior architects, engineers, and Scrum Masters who've shipped for banking, healthcare, government, and Fortune 500 clients. We size the team to your stage and your budget.

rows.title: Proven Scrum process
rows.description: 1-week sprints with a working demo at the end of each one. You're never left guessing where the project stands.

rows.title: Practical AI adoption
rows.description: We use the AI tools that hold up in production and ignore the rest. To keep it honest, we follow guidance like avoiding [automation bias](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/avoid-automation-bias) — whatever the AI produces still gets reviewed and owned by a person.

rows.title: Strong engineering standards
rows.description: Public coding rules, automated checks, and mandatory code review on every change. We let AI help where it improves quality, like [automated code reviews on GitHub](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/automatic-code-reviews-github).

rows.title: Balance of quality, speed, and cost
rows.description: Most shops make you trade quality for speed or cost. We work to keep all three in a sensible balance rather than maxing out one.

paragraphs.text: SSW is for CTOs and technology leaders who need to modernize, build, or scale critical software without waiting months to hire a full team.

items.question: How should I choose an AI-assisted software development partner?

paragraphs.text: Pick a partner that has actually shipped software, not just demos. Look for solid engineering habits, open communication, and senior people who stick around for the whole build.
The tools matter less than how a team uses them. We pair AI with 30+ years of consulting experience, so you get the speed without losing the accountability.

items.question: What are the benefits of working with SSW versus building in-house?

paragraphs.text: Hiring senior engineers takes months. We can start in about two weeks with a full team — engineers, a Scrum Master, and an architect — so there's no recruiting drag and no bad-hire risk on something that matters.
You own the code, the IP, and the way it was built. When you're ready to take it in-house, we hand it over cleanly.

items.question: How does SSW combine AI speed with enterprise quality?

paragraphs.text: With process. AI speeds up the typing, not the thinking. Every change goes through the same steps — spec, code review, automated test, staged deploy — with senior engineers involved the whole way.
So it ships quickly and keeps working after it does.
